p: ninth year: Of Jeconiah's captivity and of the reign of Zedekiah, 2Ki 25:1.
month: Called Tebeth, which contains part of December and part of January: in which month and day Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem.
pot: By which was meant Jerusalem.
pieces into it: That is the citizens and the chief men of it.
bones under it: Meaning, of the innocents whom they had slain, who were the cause of the kindling of God's wrath against them.
whose scum is in it: Whose iniquities and wicked citizens there yet remain.
piece by piece: Signifying that they should not be destroyed all at once, but little by little.
lot fall upon it: Spare no estate or condition.
rock: The city showed her cruelty to all the world, and was not ashamed of it, neither yet hid it.
kindle the fire: Meaning that the city would be utterly destroyed and that he would give the enemies an appetite for it.
She hath wearied herself with lies: The city has flattered herself in vain.
have purged thee: I laboured by sending my prophets to call you to repentance but you would not.
they judge thee: That is, the Babylonians.
desire of thy eyes with a: Meaning his wife in whom he delighted, as in Eze 24:18.
and put on thy shoes upon: For in mourning they went bare headed and barefooted and also covered their lips.
not the bread of men: That is, which the neighbours sent to them that mourned.
in the morning as I was: Meaning the morning following.
profane my sanctuary: By sending the Chaldeans to destroy it, as in Geneva "Eze 7:22".
excellence of your strength: In which you boast and delight.
